footer.desc: Aura Finance is an enterprise-grade platform designed to revolutionize financial operations. By leveraging advanced artificial intelligence, we automate tedious tasks like invoice extraction, expense tracking, and complex approval workflows. Our mission is to empower modern finance teams to reduce manual errors, scale efficiently, and make data-driven decisions with absolute confidence.

home.hero_subtitle: Automate, Optimize, and Scale with Aura Finance's enterprise-grade platform.

features.title: Powerful Features for Modern Finance
features.subtitle: Everything you need to automate, track, and scale your financial operations with enterprise-grade security and advanced AI capabilities.
features.f1_desc: Say goodbye to manual data entry. Our proprietary AI models automatically extract key information from uploaded invoices with 99.9% accuracy. From line items to tax totals, Aura understands complex documents instantly.
features.f2_desc: Route expenses exactly how your company operates. Build custom, multi-tiered approval chains based on department, amount thresholds, or specific project codes.
features.f3_desc: Turn your raw financial data into actionable insights. Aura generates real-time reports on cash flow, departmental spending, and forecast models using machine learning.
features.f4_desc: Your financial data is protected by best-in-class encryption. Manage granular permissions to ensure employees only see the data relevant to their roles.
features.cta_title: Ready to transform your financial stack?

ttn.title: Seamless TTN Compliance
ttn.subtitle: Aura Finance is fully integrated with Tunisia's TradeNet (TTN). Automatically validate, extract, and submit electronic invoices in perfect compliance with national standards.
ttn.multi_region_desc: Data is localized and stored according to regional compliance laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). TTN seamlessly routes requests to the geographically nearest compliant data center.
ttn.high_availability_desc: With 99.99% guaranteed uptime, our infrastructure is distributed across highly available clusters, ensuring your finance operations never skip a beat.
ttn.bespoke_desc: We provide isolated environments for large organizations to train our machine learning models on their specific, proprietary invoice formats.
ttn.talk_to_architect: Talk to an architect about TTN deployment

pricing.title: Transparent Pricing for Every Scale
pricing.subtitle: Start automating your financial operations today. Simple pricing, no hidden fees.

about.subtitle: Aura Finance was built with a single mission: to eliminate the friction from financial operations so businesses can focus on growth.
about.story_p1: We realized that finance teams were spending countless hours on manual data entry, invoice processing, and navigating clunky legacy software. This wasn't just inefficient; it was holding businesses back.
about.story_p2: Aura Finance was born out of the necessity for a smarter, faster, and more intuitive financial platform. By leveraging cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence, we automate the tedious tasks, ensure compliance with national standards like TTN, and provide real-time insights that actually matter.
about.story_p3: Today, we are proud to serve enterprises that trust us to handle their most critical financial workflows, giving them back their most valuable asset: time.
about.innovation_desc: We constantly push the boundaries of what AI can do for finance.
about.security_desc: Bank-grade encryption and strict compliance protocols.
about.user_centric_desc: Software that your team will actually love to use.
about.precision_desc: Near 100% accuracy in invoice and receipt extraction.
about.ready_to_transform: Ready to transform your finance operations?
about.join_growing: Join the growing number of companies that use Aura Finance to scale effortlessly.

pricing_faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pricing_faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about billing and plans.
pricing_faq.q1: How does the billing cycle work?
pricing_faq.a1: We offer both monthly and annual billing options. Annual plans come with a 20% discount applied automatically.
pricing_faq.a2: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Prorated charges or credits will automatically be applied to your account.
pricing_faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing_faq.a3: We accept all major credit cards, wire transfers for Enterprise customers, and standard local bank transfers.
pricing_faq.a4: No, unless you choose an Enterprise custom agreement. Standard plans are strictly month-to-month or year-to-year.
pricing_faq.q5: Is there a free trial available?
pricing_faq.a5: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial on the Pro plan so you can test our automation capabilities with your own documents.
pricing_faq.q6: What kind of support is included?
pricing_faq.a6: Basic includes email support. Pro includes priority email and chat support. Enterprise includes a dedicated account manager and 24/7 phone support.

services_page.title: Overview
services_page.subtitle: Discover and enable the smart services available on Aura Finance.

extraction.title: AI Extraction Service
extraction.desc: Leverage state-of-the-art deep learning and optical character recognition (OCR) to automatically extract key metadata (invoice numbers, dates, tax amounts, line items, and totals) from PDF, JPEG, and PNG invoices with a 99.9% accuracy rate, eliminating manual data entry.

ttn.title: TTN E-Invoicing Connection
ttn.desc: Connect your account directly to the Tunisian TradeNet (TTN) portal for instant, automated validation of electronic invoices. Fully verify compliance with local trade regulations and synchronize transaction statuses in real-time.

app_conn.title: App Integration (API Key)
app_conn.desc: Access secure, high-throughput developer REST APIs and SDKs to integrate Aura Finance directly into your existing ERP systems, accounting software, custom business tools, and internal database structures.

telegram.title: Telegram AI Bot Services
telegram.desc: Activate the smart AI-powered Telegram assistant to upload invoices on the go, track approval workflows, receive instant push notifications for rejected or pending bills, and query real-time financial stats directly via mobile.

comparison.title: Competitor Price Comparison
comparison.desc: Utilize advanced pricing intelligence algorithms to benchmark vendor unit prices against current market indexes and historical supplier quotes. Identify cost savings, detect overcharges, and renegotiate terms with solid market analytics.
